t: This is the statue of Samuel Johnson, a Grade II listed monument from 1910, standing on the Strand in the churchyard of St Clement Danes. It depicts Dr Johnson, the writer best known for his Dictionary of the English Language of 1755, which has 42,733 entries. The Oxford Dictionary of National Biography calls him arguably the most distinguished man of letters in English history. The statue was made by Percy Hetherington Fitzgerald, an Anglo-Irish author and critic who was also a painter and sculptor.
